question: What should Predictability mean on a PR?

options.label: Foreseeable behaviour (Recommended)
options.consequence: the same inputs give the same result, and what a step will do is stated (plan, dry run, refusal) before it acts

options.label: Determinism only
options.consequence: the same inputs give the same output; says nothing about telling the maintainer in advance

options.label: Delivery forecast
options.consequence: how well the effort time and cost can be estimated in advance
